senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; preced.) laziness, indolence. Yalk. Num. 720; Pes. 66ᵃ מי גרם … ע׳ שהיתה בכם וכ׳ what is the cause that I had to come from Babylonia and be appointed your chief? Your indolence, which prevented you from waiting upon the two greatest men of the generation.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 117a:13">Ib. 117ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 31a:11">Ber. 31ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="P01099"><he>עֲצֵבוּת</he></cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 8:3:2">Y. Kil. VIII, 31ᶜ</cite> (of an animal tied by the side of a harnessed animal) <he>זה נושא עַצְלוּתוֹ של זה וכ׳</he> this one carries the sluggishness of the other, i.e. when one is sluggish, the other has to carry the heavier load.
